name: decision-wiki
description: Git-first decision Wiki toolkit for installing, upgrading, and recording reviewable repository decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Install a decision Wiki and record settled repository decisions
interface.longDescription: A Git-first decision knowledge-base toolkit with setup-decision-wiki for installing or upgrading the decision Wiki and save-decision for drafting explicitly settled repository decisions for review.
defaultPrompt: 用 setup-decision-wiki 在這個 repository 建立決策知識庫
用 save-decision 將已確認的技術決策建立成草稿
檢查這個 repository 的 decision Wiki 是否需要升級
